name: new habit flow creates a daily habit

payload.text: Welcome — let’s make room for one small habit. Your timezone helps reminders arrive at the right local time.
Got it — reminders will use UTC. Tap Create habit when you’re ready.
What habit would you like to build? Type a short name.
How often should you do it?
What local time should I remind you? Send it like 08:30.

Your habit: Read
Every day at 08:30 (UTC)
You’re all set for Read. I’ll remind you at 08:30 in UTC.
Done — Read is on your streak.

name: timezone accepts an IANA local timezone

payload.text: Send your timezone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.
Got it — reminders will use Europe/London. Now let’s name your first habit.
